title: Recorded UCI Wine feature-correlation diagnostic
scope: All178 records, no class-based fitting. Dimensionless sample correlation. Finite descriptive association comparison, not proof of Gaussian sampling or causation; MP is a separate limit reference.
permutationAssumptions: Column independence and row exchangeability would justify the conditional permutation reference. The collection protocol is not established here.
units: Recorded feature units not inferred; standardized coordinates and correlation eigenvalues are dimensionless.
